mechanism: Indomethacin inhibits renal prostaglandin synthesis and may reduce dronedarone clearance via CYP3A4 inhibition, while NSAIDs increase cardiovascular and arrhythmia risk in patients on antiarrhythmic therapy.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor heart rate, blood pressure, renal function, and signs of fluid retention closely, and consider alternative analgesia.
